name: CISplatin + Pemetrexed (NSCLC, non-squamous)
cyclesNote: Cycle count is not asserted here: the encoded cisplatin 75 / pemetrexed 500 doses are grounded to the NSCL-F concurrent-chemoradiation entry, which specifies 3 cycles at these doses (NSCL-F line 4810). PROCLAIM likewise used 3 cycles during concurrent radiation (DeVita line 68903 to 68904); JIPANG used these doses in the adjuvant setting without a cycle count printed in the corpus (lines 68600 to 68601). The number of cycles for this doublet as systemic therapy is setting-dependent (metastatic first-line, neoadjuvant, or adjuvant) and is left to clinical review; pemetrexed continuation maintenance may follow in the metastatic setting per clinical review.

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic platinum/pemetrexed doublet. Pemetrexed is restricted to NON-squamous NSCLC. This regimen is for NSCLC without an actionable oncogenic driver: patients with EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R, ALK, ROS1, RET, or other targetable driver alterations are directed to targeted therapy first-line, not a cytotoxic doublet. Broad molecular profiling and PD-L1 testing are recommended before first-line therapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Principles of Perioperative Systemic Therapy (NSCL-E) and Principles of Molecular and Biomarker Analysis.

histology: non-squamous (adenocarcinoma, large cell carcinoma, or NSCLC not otherwise specified); NOT for squamous cell carcinoma (pemetrexed is restricted to non-squamous histology)

premedications.name: Pemetrexed supplementation
premedications.notes: folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation started before pemetrexed; dexamethasone premedication to reduce rash, per pemetrexed labeling.

premedications.name: Cisplatin hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration with cisplatin to protect renal function.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: cisplatin is highly emetogenic; give high emetic-risk antiemetic prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: cisplatin-based regimen is high emetic risk; prophylaxis required on day of treatment
cisplatin hydration to reduce nephrotoxicity; monitor renal function, hearing, and peripheral neuropathy
pemetrexed: folic acid + vitamin B12 + dexamethasone premedication
monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle - cisplatin nephrotoxicity
audiometry/hearing and peripheral neuropathy assessment - cisplatin ototoxicity and neurotoxicity
adequate folic acid / B12 supplementation for pemetrexed

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold or reduce per protocol-specific hematologic criteria; physician decides.
Cisplatin is nephrotoxic; consider carboplatin substitution or dose modification if renal function declines. Clinical review required.

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4810 (Cisplatin 75 mg/m2 Day 1). Corroborated in DeVita 12th ed.: PROCLAIM used cisplatin 75 mg/m2 plus pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 every 3 weeks (line 68904); JIPANG adjuvant arm cisplatin 75 mg/m2 plus pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Day 1 every 21 days (lines 68600 to 68601). ISMP tall-man (CISplatin). Cisplatin requires vigorous IV hydration and monitoring for nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and neurotoxicity.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2 (Concurrent Chemoradiation Regimens, nonsquamous): Cisplatin 75 mg/m2 on Day 1, Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 on Day 1 every 21 days (line 4810)

drugs.name: Pemetrexed
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F line 4810 (Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 Day 1). Non-squamous histology only. Requires folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation plus dexamethasone premedication per pemetrexed labeling. Corroborated in DeVita 12th ed. line 68904 (PROCLAIM).
